articles.title: A Simple Liquid Can Stop Cavities — No Drilling Needed
articles.summary: A major trial confirms a painted-on liquid called SDF can stop cavities in young children without drilling — though it darkens the treated spot.

articles.title: Green Sea Turtles Are Bouncing Back — But the Job Isn't Done
articles.summary: After a 1968 hunting ban, Aldabra's green turtles went from a few thousand nests to more than 15,000 clutches — yet some populations still need help.

articles.title: Circular Cities: Fix It, Reuse It, Don't Trash It
articles.summary: Around 100 cities are turning trash into treasure by repairing, reusing, and recycling — from Austin's toy-repair clinics to Amsterdam's rain-cooled sports fields.
